newsitem.title: USA: America Online to charge retailers rent - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: America Online to charge retailers rent - WSJ.

text.p: America Online Inc will shift its model for online commerce by collecting "rent" from its electronic retailers rather than relying mainly on a cut of their sales, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the paper said that collecting even a tiny percentage of every electronic transaction has long been touted as a solid way of collecting.
But now America Online believes that approach is not the best way to jump-start retailers sales, the paper said.
The problem with commissions, the article said, was a lack of risk for retailers.
There was no penalty for failing to generate sales, so merchants could afford to treat their online storefronts as experiments, the paper said.
Online sales at America Online have fallen short of expectations, the paper said, luring the company to the idea of guaranteed revenue paid up front.
The new system is expected to be launched next month, the article said.
America Online informed merchants of the change last week, the article said.
